description: Returns a step-by-step checklist a business should complete before licensing its data: ownership and contract checks, privacy-policy review, de-identification and re-identification risk, vendor terms, provenance records and permitted uses, plus the privacy laws to review for the selected data types. Use when someone asks what permissions, consents or legal checks they need before selling or licensing business data. General information, not legal advice; stores nothing.

contains_health_info.description: True if any records include health or patient information. Yes/no only. Optional.

contains_personal_info.description: Whether the records include personal information. Optional.

data_location.description: Whether the data is stored in the business's own systems, in third-party software, or both. Optional.

data_types.description: Kinds of records the business is considering licensing.

hq_region.description: Region of the business's headquarters. Optional.

sells_to.description: Whether the business sells to businesses, consumers or both. Optional.

name: get_data_rights_checklist
title: Get data rights checklist
